operator_io_quirks: Table 'CBSA' is mixed-case; column 'CBSA' in zip_data shares the name of table CBSA (identifier vs table ambiguity in generated SQL).
Column '1st_quarter_payroll' starts with a digit; must be double-quoted everywhere.
Column 'type' is a SQL keyword; 'state' is both a column name and a table name; 'CBSA' likewise.
congress PK column is misspelled 'cognress_rep_id' (typo in DDL); FK from zip_congress.district references it.
zip_data.CBSA is a FK to CBSA.CBSA with 57.6% NULLs; parent has 465 rows, child 41563 — many-to-one, non-unique parent side is fine but child draws with replacement.
zip_data.state is TEXT FK to state.abbreviation (62 rows) but zip_data has 62 distinct state values; congress.abbreviation also FK to state.abbreviation (55 distinct).
country.state is a FK to state.abbreviation but has 0.7% NULLs and 57 distinct — NULL FK values must survive.
Composite PKs: area_code(zip_code,area_code), avoid(zip_code,bad_alias), country(zip_code,county), zip_congress(zip_code,district) — all also FK children of zip_data(zip_code).
zip_data is the hub: 41563 rows, 60 columns, referenced by alias, area_code, avoid, country, zip_congress; reading it dominates cost.
congress.District is INTEGER with 20.2% NULLs; zip_congress.district is TEXT storing values like 'NY-1','PR' — storage class contradicts declared type across the FK.
zip_data.zip_code samples start at 501 (not 1); Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from 'INTEGER' (no args) => default scale, will produce values far outside [501,99950].
No NOT NULL constraints anywhere (notnull=0 on every column); CHECK/UNIQUE not declared in DDL text.
operator_ts_expectations: All TEXT columns dispatch to String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z 0-9() strings of length 0..20, plus 50% contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop char) — names like 'first_name','city','party' become gibberish.

All INTEGER/REAL columns dispatch to Number fuzzer: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale from type args; INTEGER has none => default), then +-1/+-2 perturbation — zip_code, population, payroll all implausible magnitudes.
String fuzzer adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements, so 'zip_code' TEXT-ish values may appear; but zip_code is INTEGER so Number path.

FK columns (zip_data.CBSA, zip_data.state, congress.abbreviation, country.state, zip_congress.district, all zip_code FKs) draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement — ties/duplicates guaranteed, but only among parent's generated values.

zip_data.CBSA has 57.6% NULLs in original; TS does not enforce NOT NULL, so NULLs appear only if parent column sampler emits them (Number sampler drops None) — likely 0% NULL in generated, unlike original.
Composite-PK members get max_l0=30 (fresh-draw cap), single-column PK gets inf — zip_code (PK of zip_data) will be all-fresh, area_code/avoid/country/zip_congress PK members capped.

String fuzzer on 'type','multi_county','daylight_savings','region','division','party','House' (2-9 distinct) will produce random strings, destroying the low-cardinality ENUM structure — likely FN driver for queries filtering on these.
Number fuzzer on 'latitude','longitude' (REAL, ~[-180,180]) produces values in [-10^scale,10^scale] with default scale — implausible coordinates, FN for range predicates.
Number fuzzer on 'population_2020','annual_payroll' (up to 10^8) with default scale may under- or over-shoot; list-range quirk (min(el)..full max) keeps some plausibility.

String fuzzer on 'cognress_rep_id' (values 'AK','AK-S1','AL-1') and 'district' ('NY-1','PR') produces random strings; joins zip_congress.district=congress.cognress_rep_id still work (FK consistency) but values implausible.
Empty parent (e.g. if state filtered to 0 rows) yields NULL FK values — but state has 62 rows and PK inf cap, so unlikely empty; still a risk for small tables.
No Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns in this DB — those fuzzers unused; all dispatch is String or Number.
